description: This file defines the OAuth class, a wrapper for OAuth2 authentication using the league/oauth2-client package within the PHPMailer project. It manages OAuth tokens, refreshes tokens when expired, and generates OAuth authorization headers.

classes.name: OAuth
classes.description: OAuth class providing OAuth2 authentication via a wrapper that manages tokens and credentials.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes OAuth object with provider and credential options.

methods.name: getGrant
methods.description: Returns a new RefreshToken grant object.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Obtains a new access token from the provider using the refresh token.

methods.name: getOauth64
methods.description: Returns a base64-encoded OAuth token string, refreshing the token if needed.
